"""Identifier case conversion."""

from __future__ import annotations


def snake_case(text: str) -> str:
    """Convert an identifier or phrase to ``snake_case``.

    Spaces, hyphens and underscores separate words. A lowercase-to-uppercase
    transition, an uppercase letter after a digit, or an acronym's final
    capital that begins a following capitalised word also start a new word.
    A run of consecutive uppercase letters stays together (``HTTPServer`` ->
    ``http_server``, ``XMLHttpRequest`` -> ``xml_http_request``, ``userID`` ->
    ``user_id``). The result is lowercase, never contains two underscores in a
    row, and never starts or ends with one.

    Args:
        text: Input identifier, e.g. ``camelCase``, ``PascalCase`` or
            ``kebab-case``.

    Returns:
        The ``snake_case`` form of ``text``.
    """
    pieces: list[str] = []
    for index, char in enumerate(text):
        if char in " -_":
            if pieces and pieces[-1] != "_":
                pieces.append("_")
            continue

        if (
            char.isupper()
            and index > 0
            and pieces
            and pieces[-1] != "_"
        ):
            prev = text[index - 1]
            next_char = text[index + 1] if index + 1 < len(text) else ""
            starts_new_word = (
                prev.islower()
                or prev.isdigit()
                or (prev.isupper() and next_char.islower())
            )
            if starts_new_word:
                pieces.append("_")

        pieces.append(char.lower())
    return "".join(pieces).strip("_")
